entities.summary: The Faculty of Political Sciences in Sarajevo or FPN is one of the 24 faculties of the University of Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. The faculty was formed in 1961 as the former "High School of Political Sciences in Sarajevo" and is located in the urban area of Sarajevo.
